RESIDENTIAL RENTAL AGREEMENT
This agreement is made at Pune between the Owner, Sample Owner A, and the Tenant, Sample Tenant A.
1. Premises
The Owner lets the flat at Building 4, Sample Nagar, Pune, to the Tenant for residential use.
2. Term
This agreement is for a period of eleven (11) months from the date of possession.
3. Rent
The Tenant shall pay monthly rent of Rs. 25,000 on or before the fifth day of each month.
4. Security Deposit
The Tenant shall pay a security deposit of Rs. 50,000, equivalent to two months' rent. The deposit shall be refunded within 15 days of the Tenant handing over vacant possession, after deducting only unpaid rent, unpaid bills and damage beyond normal wear and tear, supported by bills.
5. Maintenance and Bills
Society maintenance charges and property tax shall be paid by the Owner. Electricity and water charges for actual use shall be paid by the Tenant.
6. Repairs
The Tenant shall carry out minor repairs up to Rs. 1,500 per instance. Structural and major repairs are the Owner's responsibility.
7. Entry
The Owner may inspect the premises after giving at least 24 hours written notice to the Tenant, except in an emergency.
8. Notice
Either party shall give one month's written notice to end this agreement.
9. Sale of Property
If the property is sold, this agreement shall bind the new owner for the remaining term.
10. Disputes
Any dispute shall be decided by the courts at Pune.
